title: Percy Jackson Season 3 Puts Percy and Thalia's Rivalry to the Test
excerpt:
A rescue mission changes the dynamics at Camp Half-Blood.
The opening episodes also deepen the show's central relationships.
body_md:
Spoiler warning: this report discusses events in the opening episodes of Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3. The new season begins with Percy and Annabeth joining forces with Thalia, the daughter of Zeus, to help rescue Nico and Bianca di Angelo. But bringing powerful young demigods together does not mean they agree on how to lead.

Walker Scobell returns as Percy, Leah Sava Jeffries plays Annabeth, and Tamara Smart portrays Thalia. The tension between Percy and Thalia is especially pronounced because both care deeply about Annabeth while disagreeing on strategy and responsibility. Their shared loyalty becomes a source of conflict rather than an immediate solution.

The situation grows more urgent when Annabeth is taken to an enemy stronghold. What begins as a quest becomes an emotional test of trust, friendship and emerging romantic feelings. The new episodes are less concerned with simply assembling a team than with showing how difficult it can be for that team to remain united when someone they love is in danger. Season 3 is streaming on Disney+.
